descriptions.preferred: This beautiful little plant is the variegated form of the excellent dwarf 'Kotohime', and the name means "dwarf multicolored old harp. " The basic color of the foliage is a rich green, with each leaf varying in the amount of variegation. Some are completely marked with tiny flecks and speckles; others are solid green. The markings are always minute, often overlapping, and are white, cream, light yellow, pink, and red. The individual tones are subdued, but the total effect is quite brilliant in the spring. The newest growth tips are often quite pink as they develop, but soon assume the normal variegation. As the summer approaches, the leaves take on a darker green color. They are quite small, measuring 2-3 cm long and wide. Each leaf has five lobes radiating outward and di- Archives, Corvallis The growth of the plant is very slow and stubby. The distance between pairs of leaf buds is very short, sometimes 5-10 mm and even less on side shoots. Leader shoots rarely grow more than 2-5 cm per season. Side branching is often profuse, thus making a very dense compact small plant. It is indeed a true dwarf selection of less than 1 m tall. This variegated cultivar is quite rare, even less well known than its green counterpart

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一株非常漂亮的小型植株，为优良矮生品种 'Kotohime' 的斑锦型，其名称意为“多彩的矮小古琴”。 叶片底色为浓绿色，但每片叶上的斑锦程度各不相同：有些几乎布满细小斑点与碎斑，有些则为纯绿色。 斑纹始终十分细微，常彼此重叠，颜色包括白色、乳白色、浅黄色、粉色和红色。 单独看各色调较为柔和，但春季整体观感十分明丽。 最新抽生的枝梢在展开时常带明显粉色，随后逐渐转为正常的斑锦状态。 入夏后，叶色会变得更深绿。 叶片很小，长宽均为 2-3 厘米。 每片叶有 5 个向外放射的裂片，并深裂。 植株生长极其缓慢且节间短缩。 成对叶芽之间距离极短，有时仅 5-10 毫米，侧枝上甚至更短。 主梢每季很少生长超过 2-5 厘米。 侧枝分生常很旺盛，因此形成极为致密紧凑的小型植株。 它确实是一个真正的矮生选系，高度不足 1 米。 这一斑锦品种十分罕见，知名度甚至低于其绿色原种
